programs.title: The Knick
programs.desc: New York, the first years of the 20th century.Brilliant surgeon Dr. John Thackery (Clive Owen) leads a brave team of young medics at Knickerbocker Hospital.The doctor introduces pioneering medical solutions while struggling with cocaine addiction.His team is making breakthroughs in medicine at a time when antibiotics do not yet exist and patient mortality is terrifyingly high.The group of distinguished medical staff includes, among others:protégé Everett Gallinger (Eric Johnson) and Algernon Edwards (Andre Holland), a promising surgeon from Europe who was included in the team against Thackery's wishes.The series is directed by Oscar winner Steven Soderbergh.

actor: Dr. John W. Thackery - Clive Owen

programs.title: Perry Mason
programs.desc:
Los Angeles, 1931.The United States is in the depths of the Great Depression, but the City of Angels is booming.There is no shortage of oil, sound films or even the Olympic Games.The image of a beautiful and wonderful city is spoiled by one incident.There's a kidnapping that didn't go according to plan.The case is handled by detective Perry Mason (Matthew Rhys).It quickly turns out that it will turn his life upside down.An investigator uncovers Los Angeles's darkest secrets, and his search for the truth may allow him to redeem himself.A series referring to the works of Erle Stanley Gardner, author of the cult series about Perry Mason, criminal defense lawyer
Los Angeles, 1931. A one-year-old boy, Charlie, is kidnapped.His parents, Matthew and Emily Dodson, receive a ransom demand - as much as one hundred thousand dollars.Attorney E.B.Jonathan enlists a private detective, Perry Mason, on the case.The investigators, together with their assistant Pete Strickland, direct their steps to millionaire Herman Baggerly.This man is on the council of the church attended by the parents of the abducted child.The detective tries to find out why the criminals set such a high sum, even though the boy's family is not wealthy.
